title: Super Bowl 50
overview: Super Bowl 50, played on February 7, 2016, at Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, California, marked a historic moment in NFL history as the Denver Broncos defeated the Carolina Panthers 24-10 to win their third Super Bowl title. The game, which celebrated the NFL’s 50th championship, was defined by the Broncos’ suffocating defense and a strong performance from quarterback Peyton Manning, in what would be his final game.
